conf.description: Windows DNS Server dns.log debug grammar: PACKET-header regex_extract (first physical line; multiline join assumed to happen at the Source's Event Breaker), Direction-aware IP assignment, flag/opcode expansion, label-length QNAME reassembly, before batched rename.

conf.comment: windows-dns-dhcp/dns-analytical/syslog-raw (dns.log debug grammar). ASSUMES the Source's Event Breaker groups each PACKET header line (this regex targets only the first physical line); a true multiline join is Source-level config, out of scope for a pipeline. The header column layout is reconstructed from public documentation, NOT confirmed against a captured sample from this estate (README gap). No LPAR/server UTC offset exists in this work order, so _time is naive local time (same gap category used elsewhere). Flags(hex) bit-level decode is not implemented (no bit-position table given); registered_domain/subdomain/tld derivation needs a public-suffix-list lookup this instance does not have, so it is skipped rather than invented. event.dataset targets 'microsoft_dnsserver.analytical' per route_direct's own data_stream name, not the generic tech-id.dataset-id formula, since recommendations.direct.elastic explicitly names that integration.

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.

extract the PACKET header line's fixed-position fields; captures only the first physical line of a (possibly multi-line) event, using [^\n] rather than a $/multiline anchor so trailing decoded-section lines are never required to match

combine Date+Time into _time, parse the hex thread id, lowercase transport, resolve Direction-dependent source/destination/related.ip, expand Opcode and the flag character codes, derive event.outcome from Response Code, and reassemble the label-length Question Name into a dotted FQDN -- all from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename
batch-rename status:mapped/custom fields that need no further transform
tag event.dataset per route_direct's own data_stream name, and drop the raw header-component keys fully consumed above
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
